title: The Chaldean Oracles, Vol. 1
author: G. R. S. Mead
description: The first volume of G. R. S. Mead's presentation of the Chaldean Oracles. These fragmentary religious and philosophical sayings became important to later Neoplatonists, linking divine intellect, cosmic order and the soul's ascent.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/the-chaldean-oracles-vol.-1-echoes-from-the-gnosis-volume-viii).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
